name: Render a Blender project to PNG
description: Opens a .blend file headless, renders the active camera to a PNG with the chosen engine and resolution, and verifies the image exists.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: AUTO (Cycles on CPU — works headless everywhere), CYCLES, BLENDER_EEVEE, BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT (4.2+) or BLENDER_WORKBENCH. EEVEE/Workbench need an OpenGL-capable display.

steps.title: Render the active camera to PNG

args.code:
import bpy, os
out = r"{{output_path}}"
engine = "{{engine}}"
scene = bpy.context.scene
if scene.camera is None:
    cams = [o for o in scene.objects if o.type == 'CAMERA']
    if not cams:
        raise RuntimeError('The scene has no camera')
    scene.camera = cams[0]
try:
    import addon_utils
    addon_utils.enable('cycles', default_set=True)
except Exception:
    pass

def use(e):
    try:
        scene.render.engine = e
        return True
    except TypeError:
        return False

# AUTO prefers Cycles on the CPU: it is the only engine that renders without a GPU/OpenGL context.
order = ['CYCLES', 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT', 'BLENDER_EEVEE', 'BLENDER_WORKBENCH'] if engine == 'AUTO' else [engine]
chosen = next((e for e in order if use(e)), None)
if chosen is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Render engine %s is not available in this Blender build' % engine)
if chosen == 'CYCLES':
    scene.cycles.samples = int("{{samples}}")
    scene.cycles.device = 'CPU'
    # Distribution builds may lack OpenImageDenoise; denoising is optional for a still.
    scene.cycles.use_denoising = False
scene.render.resolution_percentage = int("{{resolution_percentage}}")
scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'
scene.render.filepath = out
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
print('RENDER_OK engine=%s file=%s' % (chosen, out))

hints.notes: Background rendering with EEVEE/Workbench needs OpenGL; AUTO uses Cycles on the CPU, which always works but is slower — keep samples and resolution low for previews.

failure_modes.symptom: Unable to open a display / EEVEE fails in background mode
failure_modes.recovery: Re-run with engine CYCLES (CPU) or BLENDER_WORKBENCH.
Add a camera (bpy.ops.object.camera_add) and point it at the scene before rendering.
Set scene.cycles.use_denoising = False (already done by this workflow for Cycles) or use another engine.

notes: GUI alternative: open the file, press F12, then Image > Save As in the render window (see blender/render-png-gui).
